rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Acidity order: HC≡CH > terminal alkynes > alkenes > alkanes — sp (50% s) > sp² (33%) > sp³ (25%) s-character pulls the electron pair; tests: AgNO3/NH3 white ppt, Cu2Cl2/NH3 red ppt.  ·  Trick 2: Addition sequence: alkyne + X2 → trans-dihaloalkene (anti addition) → tetrahalide; + HX twice → gem-dihalide (Markovnikov both times).

rows.text: Trick 3: Hydration (H2SO4/HgSO4): terminal alkyne → methyl ketone (Markovnikov enol → keto); only ethyne gives acetaldehyde — the exception to remember.  ·  Trick 4: Polymerisation: 3C2H2 → benzene (red-hot tube); 2C2H2 → vinyl acetylene (CuCl/NH4Cl) — two products, two catalysts.  ·  define + example each sub-idea: alkynes, preparation, acidic character, addition reactions.
